# SARTOR Lahore - Women's Bespoke Tailoring & Stitching Atelier
> Premier women's bespoke tailoring, designer stitching, hand/machine embroidery, fabric sourcing, and doorstep pick-and-drop service in Lahore, Pakistan.

## Business Profile
- **Brand Name**: SARTOR
- **Domain**: sartor.pk (https://sartor.pk)
- **Primary Category**: Women's Bespoke Tailoring, Luxury Stitching Atelier, Custom Couture
- **Location**: Moon Tower, International Market, Model Town, Lahore, Punjab 54700, Pakistan
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +92 335 2209991 (0335-2209991)
- **WhatsApp Direct**: https://wa.me/923352209991
- **Email**: contact@sartor.pk
- **Operating Hours**: Monday - Saturday: 11:00 AM - 9:30 PM PKT | Sunday: 2:00 PM - 8:00 PM PKT

## Stitching Services & Transparent Rate List (PKR)
- **Simple Everyday / Pret Suit**: PKR 2,500
  - Turnaround: 3 - 4 Days
  - Details: 2-piece or 3-piece kurti and trouser/shalwar stitching with overlock interior seams and clean neck facing. Suitable for lawn, linen, jacquard, and cotton fabrics.
- **Structured Layered Double Suit**: PKR 4,000
  - Turnaround: 4 - 6 Days
  - Details: Floor-length sheer organza coat over tailored slip kurti with matching cigarette pants. Double-stitched concealed slip lining and tapered trousers.
- **16-Kali Kalidar Panneled Frock**: PKR 7,000
  - Turnaround: 5 - 7 Days
  - Details: 16 symmetrical geometric kalis with wide flare, sculpted bodice, lace setting, hemline scalloping, and churidar or trousers.
- **Handcrafted Pleated Sarhi & Blouse Set**: PKR 7,000
  - Turnaround: 6 - 8 Days
  - Details: Pre-pleated pallu fall with anti-slip binding, weighted satin fall application, padded bustier blouse with invisible zipper, and custom drawstring satin petticoat.
- **Royal Bridal Lehenga & Gown Set**: PKR 10,000
  - Turnaround: 10 - 14 Days
  - Details: Heavy flared lehenga with built-in multi-layer can-can, padded choli, dual-dupatta framing with kiran border, French seams, and dedicated master cutter trial fitting.
- **Hand & Machine Embroidery**: Custom Quote
  - Techniques: Authentic zardozi, aari needlework, tilla, resham threadwork, micro-dabka, French knots, and laser scalloped borders.
- **Fabric Sourcing Service**:
  - Direct wholesale and luxury fabric sourcing from Moon Tower, Liberty Market, Ichhra, Anarkali, and Azam Cloth Market in Lahore.
- **Doorstep Pick & Drop Service**:
  - Available across all Lahore areas including Model Town, Gulberg, DHA (Phases 1-8), Cantt, Johar Town, Faisal Town, Wapda Town, and Bahria Town Lahore. Includes pressed, hanger-packed garment delivery.

## Pakistani Brand Size Chart Standardization
SARTOR accommodates standardized sizing matching top Pakistani pret fashion brands:
- **Brands Supported**: Khaadi, Sapphire, Maria.B, Sana Safinaz, Bareeze, Nishat Linen, Cross Stitch, Generation.
- **Sizes**: Extra Small (XS), Small (S), Medium (M), Large (L), Extra Large (XL).
- **Measurement Units**: Supports both Inches (") and Centimeters (cm) with an interactive size calculator.
- **Custom Measurements**: Shoulder, Chest/Bust, Waist, Hips, Kurti Length, Sleeve Length, Trouser Length, and Trouser Inseam.
